name: ml-research-loop
description: AI-driven autonomous ML experiment loop. Optimize hyperparameters, data augmentation, and model architecture using natural language.

tools.name: run_ml_experiment
tools.description: Launch an autonomous ML experiment loop to optimize hyperparameters, data augmentation, or model architecture. Best for: hyperparameter search, architecture exploration, training strategy optimization.

objective.description: What to optimize, e.g. 'minimize val_bpb on MNIST' or 'improve accuracy on CIFAR-10'

max_experiments.description: Maximum number of experiments to run (default: 50)

tools.name: get_ml_experiment_status
tools.description: Get the current status and progress of a running ML experiment

tools.name: get_ml_experiment_results
tools.description: Get the final results and best configuration from a completed ML experiment
